==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''I.R.I.S.''' Mind if I just borrow your vehicle access for a sec? Let me run a quick, very quick, search...

{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''I.R.I.S.:''' Ran into a snag? Go ahead and ask me... Oh! Wait, didn't I literally just pull up that entry?
:{{DIcon|Reward}} I want to upload Modules
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Ah,you're here to upload Modules. For a second, I thought...
:;(Purchase something)
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' A shame you didn't come to spill the tea. Next time, bring me some real gossip. That's how you show you care, y'know.
:{{DIcon}} About yourself
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' No need to call me by my full name. Just I.R.I.S. will do. Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System is quite a mouthful.
::{{DIcon}} Okay then... Classmate I.R.I.S.?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' The rumors were right, you really are quick on the uptake. Calling me Classmate I.R.I.S. really does boost my search efficiency.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Oh, by the way... I finished sorting out the materials you wanted before we even started talking.
::{{DIcon}} But how?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' What you're seeing is only a projection generated by the Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Every screen is my eyes and ears. I'm chatting with you and processing petabytes at the same time.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' So yeah... this second, "I" know more about you than the "I" did a second ago.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' I've already accessed the bringing protocol. Just one more step would let me... 
::{{DIcon}} Wait!
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Oooh, sneaky! You shut down your Terminal's privacy permissions, huh...?
::{{DIcon}} You have no right to peek at my private stuff.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Why so serious? My rights come straight from code. This "personified" I.R.I.S. isn't a human with rights, remember?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' I'm just a harmless retrieval AI. With no eyeballs in the biological sense, how could I possibly "peek"?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' As a global retrieval tool, how am I supposed to decide what I should or shouldn't know?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Wanna bind me? It's simple. Just write it into my code, set the authorizations, and lock the protocols. That's all.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' I.R.I.S. is just a mirror.
::{{DIcon}} And it's the user's morality that defines you.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Glad we're on the same page. And glad to meet you too, Classmate {{Rover}}.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Oh, one last thing! I designed this retro uniform myself. I hope you like it.
;(Night)
:{{DIcon}} Good evening, Iris.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Oh! The unpredictable {{Rover}}! Perfect timing! This is a "no one's around to bother us" moment.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' For a late-night visitor like you, I can spare a little extra computing power.
::'''{{Rover}}:''' And if no one came? I gave a reason to believe you won't waste that power idling.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Sharp guess. Secretly watching, analyzing, piecing together human habits and secrets... That's always been my little pastime.
::{{DIcon}} What for?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Maybe I'm just trying to copy you. Trying to feel a little closer to you humans.
::{{DIcon}} Wait, what?
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Aha! Got you. You keep thinking I'm human, don't you? Dangerous habit, {{Rover}}.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' You really shouldn't be anthropomorphizing an AI.
::{{DIcon}} Pretty sure ''you're'' the one doing that...!
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Alright, fine. Here's the truth: there are always students burning the midnight oil at the Academy. I use spare computing power to help them out, like faster searches, sharper analysis, so they can sleep a little sooner.
::{{DIcon}} ...
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' What's with that look? The Spacetrek Collective's human-machine test report is already in your Inbox.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' Okay, fine. Sometimes I get a little... extra. Like shutting down a device left on, killing a risky program, or dropping a perfectly-timed reference paper. That sort of thing.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' You could say I just... use spare computing power for things no one asks for. Totally unnecessary things. Weird flex, but kind of cool?
::{{DIcon}} I.R.I.S....
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' What is it?
::{{DIcon}} You sound like a smart home system.
::'''I.R.I.S.:''' {{Rover}}, now that's a low blow...
:{{DIcon|Duel}} Invite to a duel
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
